revenue.source: MSFT 10-K FY2025 (accession 0000950170-25-100235) income statement for FY2024/FY2025; FY2026 331,839 from MSFT FY2026 10-K (accession 0001193125-26-323660) / vectorshift data table

operating_income.source: MSFT 10-K FY2025 and FY2026 (accession 0001193125-26-323660) income statements

d_and_a.source: 'Depreciation, amortization, and other' in cash flow statement as presented in the FY2026 filing/earnings release (edgar.tools, MSFT FY26 Q4 release). Note: FY2025 10-K originally showed 22,287 (FY24) and 34,153 (FY25); the FY2026 presentation is lower for prior years, so latest basis used for consistency

capex.source: 'Additions to property and equipment' in cash flow statements, FY2025 10-K and FY2026 10-K (accession 0001193125-26-323660); finance leases excluded

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2026 growth was 17.8% (331,839 vs 281,724) and FY2025 15%; fade gradually toward high-single digit as law of large numbers and AI/cloud capacity ramp mature

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2026 operating margin 46.8% (155,237/331,839), FY2025 45.6%; set slightly lower to reflect rising depreciation from heavy datacenter capex

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2025 effective rate ~17.6% (provision 21,795 / pre-tax income 123,627, FY2025 10-K); rounded up modestly

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2026 D&A 38,534/331,839 = 11.6%; rising with the capex base

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2026 capex was 34.9% of revenue (115,948) and FY2025 22.9%; assume elevated but moderating intensity, still above D&A to support growth

wacc.source: Assumption: rf ~4.3% + beta ~1.0 x ERP ~5% gives ~9% cost of equity; debt is minimal (~40bn vs trillions market cap) so WACC ≈ cost of equity; rounded 9%

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal GDP-like growth, below WACC

net_debt.source: MSFT balance sheet 6/30/2026 (FY2026 10-K, accession 0001193125-26-323660, via edgar.tools): current portion of LTD 9,227 + LTD 31,067 = 40,294 total debt (no short-term debt, leases excluded) less cash 20,935 less short-term investments 55,908 = -36,549

diluted_shares.source: Weighted average diluted shares FY2026 of 7,453 million (vectorshift table 7,453,000 thousands; MSFT FY2026 10-K)
